svg.title: AWS lab architecture: regional workload, restricted delivery and infrastructure management
svg.desc: One EC2 Nginx workload in a custom us-east-2 VPC with four subnets across two Availability Zones. Public HTTP, encrypted EBS, CloudWatch metrics and logs, dashboard, CPU alarm and SNS email. Manual GitHub delivery uses exact-commit CI authorization, OIDC and STS, a bounded IAM role and restricted SSM executor. Terraform manages infrastructure separately. Three subnets are unused; no application failover, load balancer or NAT gateway.

text.tspan: Single-instance lab • Terraform adoption • OIDC-authenticated application delivery
One workload; three subnets have no application.
No NAT gateway, load balancer or failover tier.
All subnets: public-IP auto-assignment off; the EC2 launch explicitly enables its public association.
us-east-2 · Systems Manager delivery to the existing workload
ENV_VAR inputs · seven approved file hashes
Fixed four-script sequence · lock + failure latch
SSM Agent opens outbound connections; blue arrows show logical control, not inbound network access.
